services.title: Fault Finding & Testing

services.title: Portable Appliance Testing (PAT)

about_pullquote: I built this business on doing the job right, first time, without the fluff.
about_para_1: Colin Ogden started in electrical contracting 18 years ago after becoming frustrated with overpriced, rushed jobs. Today, Colin's reputation is built on honest diagnostic work, clear quotes, and reliable service. Every job is treated with the same care whether it's a quick repair or a full rewire.
about_para_2: Customers choose Colin because he listens, explains what needs doing, and won't recommend work you don't need. He's fully NICEIC registered, keeps his knowledge current, and takes pride in leaving every job clean and properly tested. A third of his work comes from repeat customers and their neighbours.

reviews.text: Had a dodgy socket and power cut to half the kitchen. Colin came out same day, found the problem in minutes, and sorted it safely. Didn't try to sell me work I didn't need. Honest tradesman — will definitely use again.
reviews.author: Martin T.

reviews.text: Rewired our 1970s terrace before we moved in. Colin explained everything clearly, worked methodically, and the house feels so much safer now. Fair price, no mess left behind. Top bloke.
reviews.author: Rebecca L.

reviews.text: Emergency call late on a Friday when our shop went dark. Colin answered, arrived within 90 minutes, and had us back up and running. Professional and efficient. Highly recommend to any business owner.
reviews.author: David M.
